## Selected Academic Projects

### [MOBI-TWIN: Spatial Mobility and Regional Transformation in Europe's Twin Transition](../projects/mobi-twin)
**Period:** 2025 to 2026  
**Role:** Postdoctoral Researcher  
**Institution:** University of Groningen  
**Funding:** Horizon Europe  

Research on how digital and green transitions reshape spatial mobility, regional inequality, sustainability, and resilience across European regions.

### [Collaborative Planning in China (CoChina)](../projects/collaborative-planning-in-china)
**Period:** 2021 to 2025  
**Role:** Doctoral Researcher  
**Institution:** Utrecht University  
**Funding:** European Research Council Starting Grant  

Doctoral research on collaborative planning, public spheres, digital participation, and power relations in China.
